# Wave 1

# Adjust Variable `psunpartoth` and `peduoth`


```{r}
#| label: count-nonsubstantial-answers
#| eval: true

w1p_up |>
  mutate(
    nonsub = case_when(
      psundvote == 8 &
      ((psunpartoth %in% c("...", "....", "xxx", "XXX", "abc", "ABC", "K.a.", "k.A.")) |
        grepl("-1", psunpartoth) | 
        grepl("-9", psunpartoth)
       ) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0)
      
    ) |> frq(nonsub)

# 75 missings, 99 missings incl. nonsubstantial
```

```{r}
#| label: psunpartoth-and-peduoth
#| eval: true


w1p_up <- 
w1p_up |>
  mutate(
    psundvoteOthWhich = case_when(
      
      # only applies to those who answered "Other"
      psundvote != 8 ~ -2,
      
      # responded by naming a political party
      psundvote == 8 &
        # longest: Partei Mensch, Umwelt, Tierschutz
        (nchar(psunpartoth) >= 3 & nchar(psunpartoth) <= 35 &
    
        !(psunpartoth %in% c("...", "....", "xxx", "XXX", "abc", "ABC", "K.a.", "k.A.")) &
        !grepl("-1", psunpartoth) & 
        !grepl("-9", psunpartoth) &

        !grepl("Frage", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("nicht", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("NICHT", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("UMGÜLTIG", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("GEHEIM", psunpartoth)) ~ 1,
      
      
      psundvote == 8 & !(
        
        (nchar(psunpartoth) >= 3 & nchar(psunpartoth) <= 35) &
    
        !(psunpartoth %in% c("...", "....", "xxx", "XXX", "abc", "ABC", "K.a.", "k.A.")) &
        !grepl("-1", psunpartoth) & 
        !grepl("-9", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("KEIN", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("Kein", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("Frage", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("nicht", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("NICHT", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("UMGÜLTIG", psunpartoth) &
        !grepl("GEHEIM", psunpartoth)) ~ -1),
      

    
    
    
    peduOthWhich = case_when(
```

# Join w1 
## w1  `Age` & `Age_cat` & exclude `Age Inconsistency`  and `No Panelconsent`

```{r}
#| label: build-w1-and-Age
#| eval: true
  
w1p_complete <-
  # join the vars from df weights_full...
  weights_full |> select(lfd, gebjahr.weights = gebjahr) |> 
  # ...to w1p_full
  right_join(w1p_full, by = "lfd") |>
  # only take those vars and...
  select(lfd, pid, hid, gebjahr.weights) |> 
  # join them to w1p_bo, from which 
  right_join(w1p_bo |> rename(peduoth01.bo = peduoth01,
                                psunpartoth.bo = psunpartoth,
                                pedu01.bo = pedu01,
                                pedu02.bo = pedu02,
                                psundvote.bo = psundvote), 
             by = "lfd") |>
  # ... you rename one variable
  rename(pbirthyear_w1 = pbirthyear
         
         ) |> 
  
  left_join(w2p_bo |> 
              select(lfd, 
                     pbirthyear_w2 = pbirthyear,
                     intvollst_w2 = intvollst, 
                     plifesat01_w2 = plifesat01), by = "lfd") |> 
  left_join(w3p_full |>
              select(pid, 
                     pbirthyear_w3 = pbirthyear, 
                     intvollst_w3 = intvollst), by = "pid") |> 
  # join pnoinc from raw data
  left_join(w1p_up |>
              rename(peduoth01.up = peduoth01,
                     pedu01.up = pedu01,
                     psundvote.up = psundvote,
                     psunpartoth.up = psunpartoth), by = "lfd") |> 

  # use the raw (unverified) data for the free text, but take the break-off code from w1p_bo
  mutate(
    
     peduOthWhich = case_when(pedu01.bo == -10 | peduoth01.bo == -10  ~-10,
                         TRUE ~ peduOthWhich), 
    
     psundvoteOthWhich = case_when(psundvote.bo == -10| psunpartoth.bo == -10 ~-10,
                              TRUE  ~ psundvoteOthWhich),
     
     psundvoteOthWhich.text = case_when(psundvoteOthWhich == -10 ~ "-10", 
                             TRUE ~ psunpartoth.up),
     
     peduOthWhich.text = case_when(peduOthWhich == -10 ~ "-10", 
                             TRUE ~ peduoth01.up),
     
         
         # bring ppanelcons to its original pattern
         ppanelcons = case_when(
           intvollst == 3 ~ -10, 
           TRUE ~ ppanelcons),
         
     
      # if the respondent broke off before the first item, count as non-participation
         intvollst_w2 = case_when(
           plifesat01_w2 == -10 ~ NA, 
           TRUE ~ intvollst_w2)
     ) |> 
  
  rename(
    pedu01 = pedu01.bo,
    psundvote = psundvote.bo,
    pedu02 = pedu02.bo
  ) |> 
  
  select(
    - (contains("edu") & (ends_with(".bo") | ends_with(".up"))),
    - (contains("undvote") & (ends_with(".bo") | ends_with(".up"))),
    - contains("psunpartoth"))

# N = 33 obs. is.na(pbirthyear_w1) => substituted N = 7 obs. with information from gebjahr.weights, pbirthyear_w2, pbirthyear_w3  

w1p_complete <-
  w1p_complete |> mutate(
    
     PartWaves = case_when(
     
      ((intvollst_w2 %in% c(1, 2, 3)) & (intvollst_w3 %in% c(1, 2, 3))) ~ "3 waves",
      intvollst_w2 %in% c(1, 2, 3) | intvollst_w3 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "2 waves",
       
      TRUE ~ "1 wave"), 
    
    PartWaves = factor(PartWaves, levels = c("1 wave", "2 waves", "3 waves")),
    
  
    byear = case_when(
        pbirthyear_w1 > 0 ~ as.double(pbirthyear_w1),
        (is.na(pbirthyear_w1) | (pbirthyear_w1 < 0) & !is.na(gebjahr.weights)) ~ as.double(gebjahr.weights), 
        
        (is.na(pbirthyear_w1) | (pbirthyear_w1 < 0)) & 
          is.na(gebjahr.weights) & 
          pbirthyear_w2 > 0 ~ as.double(pbirthyear_w2),
        
        (is.na(pbirthyear_w1) | (pbirthyear_w1 < 0)) & 
          is.na(gebjahr.weights) & 
          (is.na(pbirthyear_w2) | (pbirthyear_w2 < 0)) & 
          pbirthyear_w3 > 0 ~ as.double(pbirthyear_w3), 
        TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    
    bmnth = case_when(
      is.na(byear)       ~ NA, 
      pbirthmnth > 0     ~ pbirthmnth,
      TRUE               ~ 1),
        
    myob = my(paste(bmnth, byear, sep = "-")),
      
    ymd_interview = ymd(interviewdatum),
      
  Age = floor(decimal_date(ymd_interview) - decimal_date(myob))) |> 
  
  filter(!is.na(pid)) #|> 
  # this removes 2 duplicate entries (lfd %in% c(...))
# nrow() #=17027
  

w1p_adults <- 
  w1p_complete |> 
# exclude n = 4 obs. of Age < 18 (2x16, 2x17yrs)
    filter(Age >= 18 | is.na(Age))  # n = 17,023


w1p_adults <- 
  w1p_adults |> 
# find  observations whose pbirthyear statements differ between the waves  
  #AgeConsistency: helper variable
  mutate(AgeConsistency = case_when(
     (as.double(pbirthyear_w1) > 0 & as.double(pbirthyear_w2) > 0 & as.double(pbirthyear_w1) != as.double(pbirthyear_w2)) |
     (as.double(pbirthyear_w1) > 0 & as.double(pbirthyear_w3) > 0 & as.double(pbirthyear_w1) != as.double(pbirthyear_w3)) |
     (as.double(pbirthyear_w2) > 0 & as.double(pbirthyear_w3) > 0 & as.double(pbirthyear_w2) != as.double(pbirthyear_w3)) ~ "Inconsistent",
      TRUE ~ "Not inconsistent")) #|>   frq(AgeConsistency) N = 279 inconsistent: THESE ARE STILL INCLUDED


w1p <- 
  w1p_adults |> 
  mutate(
    Sample = 
      case_when(
        PartWaves %in% "1 wave" | 
        AgeConsistency == "Inconsistent" ~ "sensan",
       PartWaves %in% c("2 waves", "3 waves") & AgeConsistency == "Not inconsistent" ~ "Sample"
        
      )
  ) 

w1p |> frq(Sample)

quantile(w1p$Age, prob = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
#35, 53, 65


```

**CAVE**:
- The data frame `w1p |> filter(Sample == "sensan")` is used for the sensitivity analysis. It contains all individuals aged 18 and older who participated in at least the first wave; only 2 duplicate entries were excluded.
- Subsequent computations use only `w1p |> filter(Sample %in% c("Sample"))`

```{r}
#| eval: true
```
```{r}
# function to create quartile groups with range labels
create_quantile_with_range <- function(x, varname) {
  # Compute quartiles
  quantile_group <- ntile(x, 3)
  
  # find the minimum/maximum values per group
  ranges <- tapply(x, quantile_group, function(vals) {
    c(min(vals, na.rm = TRUE), max(vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  
  # create labels
  labels <- sapply(1:3, function(i) {
    if(!is.null(ranges[[i]])) {
      sprintf("%s_T%d[%.1f-%.1f]", varname, i, ranges[[i]][1], ranges[[i]][2])
    } else {
      paste0(varname, "_T", i)
    }
  })
  
  # create the factor with labels
  factor(quantile_group, levels = 1:3, labels = labels)
}



# apply to Age in the sensitivity analysis sample
w1p <-
  w1p |>
  mutate(
    Age_cat_sensan = create_quantile_with_range(Age, "Age")
  )

# apply to Age in the analysis sample
w1p <-
  w1p |> 
  filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
  mutate(
    Age_cat_Sample = create_quantile_with_range(Age, "Age")
  ) |> 
  select(Age_cat_Sample, pid) |> 
  right_join(w1p, by = "pid")



cat("\n=== SUMMARY TABLE FOR PANELISTS ===\n")
frq(w1p$Age_cat_sensan)
frq(w1p$Age_cat_Sample)


w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  mutate(
    Age_cat_Sample = case_when(
      # derived via:
      #read_dta(paste0(datapath,"w1_up.dta")) |> filter(lfd == <case id>) |> select(contains("geb")| contains("yr") | contains("year")| contains("birth") ) |> ai()
      # NOTE: re-insert the real case id instead of the anonymization
      # placeholder "<case id>" before re-running this branch
      lfd == "<case id>" & is.na(Age_cat_Sample) ~"Age_T2[40.0-60.0]",
      TRUE ~Age_cat_Sample
    ),
    
    
    # 26 missings on Age_cat_sensan carried over to Age_cat

    Age_cat_sensan = 
           case_when(is.na(Age_cat_sensan) ~"Age_T2[41.0-61.0]",
                     TRUE ~Age_cat_sensan)
  ) 
  
w1p |> 
  frq(Age_cat_Sample, Age_cat_sensan)
```

## w1  `Gender`, `Education`, `Employment`, `ChildHH`, `PartWave`

```{r}
#| label: build-gender,-education
#| eval: true

sufw1t1 <- 
    read_dta(paste0(datapath2,"w1_pgen_long.dta")) |> filter(wave == "W1T1") |> select(-c(hid, ZG))



w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  left_join(
    sufw1t1, 
    by = c("lfd"="pid")) |>  
  mutate(    
  Education3 = case_when(
      pgisced11_scp %in% c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4) ~ "Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)",
      pgisced11_scp %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)",
      TRUE ~"missing"
  ),
   Education3 = factor(Education3, levels = c("Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)", "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)", "missing")),
  
  Education_i = case_when(
    !(Education3 %in% "missing") ~ Education3,
    
    
    Education3 %in% "missing" &
    # Priority 1: unambiguous cases (CASMIN)
    #[4] Post-secondary non-tertiary education
  pgcasmin_scp %in% c(4) ~ "Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)",
  
  Education3 %in% "missing" &
    #[5] Short-cycle tertiary education 
   pgcasmin_scp %in% c(5) ~ "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)",

  
  Education3 %in% "missing" &
      # Priority 2: unambiguous cases (pemplstat)
      pgemplst_scp == 10 ~ "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)",
  Education3 %in% "missing" &
      pgemplst_scp == 5 ~ "Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)",
      
  Education3 %in% "missing" &
      # Priority 3: pgisco08_scp
      substr(pgisco08_scp, 1, 1) %in% c("1", "2") ~ "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)",
    Education3 %in% "missing"&
      substr(pgisco08_scp, 1, 1) %in% c("3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9") ~ "Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)",
  
  Education3 %in% "missing" &
      
      # Priority 4: conservative assumptions (minijob, homemaker)
      pgemplst_scp %in% c(4, 12) ~ "Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)",
      
      TRUE ~ "missing"
    ),
  
  Education_i = factor(Education_i, levels = c("Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)", "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)", "missing")),
  
  
    Education_method = case_when(
      !(Education3 %in% "missing") ~ "original",
      !(Education_i %in% "missing") ~ "imputed",
      TRUE ~ "missing"
    ),
  
  # COLLAPSE EDUCATION CATEGORIES
  Education = 
    
    case_when(
      Education3 %in% c("Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)", "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)") ~Education3,
      
      Education3 %in% "missing" &
      Education_i  %in%  c("Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)", "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)") ~Education_i,
  
  Education3 %in% "missing" & Education_i %in% "missing" ~ "missing"),
  
  Education = factor(Education, levels = c("Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)", 
                                           "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)",
                                           "missing")),
  
    
  Gender = case_when(
   
    pgender == 2 ~ "Female",
    
    # identify as "male" or "non-binary"
    pgender %in% c(1, 3) ~ "Not female",
    # n = 136 -10, n = 37 -1
    TRUE ~ "Not female"),
    
    Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c("Female", "Not female")),
  
  
    
    Employment = case_when(
      
      pempstat1 == 1 ~ "Full-time",
      pempstat1 %in% c(2:6, 11) ~ "Part-time or flexible",
      pempstat1 == 9 ~ "Retirement",
      pempstat1 %in% c(7, 8, 10, 12, 13) ~ "Not currently employed, training",
      TRUE ~ "missing"),
    Employment = factor(Employment, levels = c("Full-time", "Part-time or flexible", "Not currently employed, training", "Retirement", "missing")),
    
    ChildHH = case_when(
      hhhage02 == 0 | hhhage03 == 1 ~ "No child in hh",
      hhhage02 > 0 & hhhage03 != 1 ~ "Child in hh",
      TRUE ~ "missing"),
    ChildHH = factor(ChildHH, levels = c("No child in hh", "Child in hh", "missing")),
    #1408 NA
    
    AllWavesComplete = case_when(
      
      #n = 7368
      (intvollst == 1 & intvollst_w2 == 1 & intvollst_w3 ==1) ~ "All waves complete",
      TRUE ~ "Not complete"),
    
    AllWavesComplete = factor(AllWavesComplete, levels = c("Not complete", "All waves complete"))
                    
  
  ) 

  

w1p |> filter(Sample == "Sample") |> select(Education3, Education_i, Education_method, Education, 
            Gender, AllWavesComplete, Employment, ChildHH) |> summary()


```



## w1 `Migration`
- self or parents' birthcountry is not Germany, or no German nationality

```{r}
#| label: migration
#| eval: true



w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  mutate(
    Mig = case_when(
      # origin is not Germany, parents not born in Germany, or no German nationality
      porigin == 2 | pmigback01 == 2| pnation01 == 0 ~ "Yes", 
      porigin < 0 & pmigback01 < 0 & pnation01 > 0 ~ "Not applicable",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    Mig = factor(Mig, levels = c( "No", "Yes"))
  ) 
```


## w1 `Income`


```{r}
#| label: build-income-variable
#| eval: true


w1p <- 
  w1p |> 

# Equivalized income: 
  # according to OECD weighting procedure (<14yrs => weight factor 0.3, >14yrs => weight factor 0.5) 
    
    rowwise() |> 
    
    mutate(
      hhsize = ifelse(hhhsize < 0, NA, hhhsize),
      u14 = ifelse(hhhage02 < 0, NA, hhhage02),
      ue14 = hhsize - u14,

      equivSize = (1 + 0.5 * (ue14 - 1) + 0.3 * u14),
      EquivIncome_num = case_when(
        hhhincnet < 0 ~ NA,
        TRUE ~ (12 * (hhhincnet/equivSize)))) |>
     ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
        EquivIncome_sensan = create_quantile_with_range(EquivIncome_num, "EquivIncome"),
        EquivIncome_sensan = case_when(
          is.na(EquivIncome_sensan) ~ "missing",
          EquivIncome_sensan == "EquivIncome_T1[0.0-20800.0]" ~ "EquivIncome_T1min",
          EquivIncome_sensan == "EquivIncome_T2[20800.0-31200.0]" ~ "EquivIncome_T2medium",
          EquivIncome_sensan == "EquivIncome_T3[31200.0-56800480.0]" ~ "EquivIncome_T3max"),
        EquivIncome_sensan = factor(EquivIncome_sensan, levels = c("EquivIncome_T2medium",
                                                     "EquivIncome_T1min",
                                                     "EquivIncome_T3max", 
                                                     "missing"))
        )

w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
  mutate(
   EquivIncome_Sample = create_quantile_with_range(EquivIncome_num, "EquivIncome"),
        EquivIncome_Sample = case_when(
          is.na(EquivIncome_Sample) ~ "missing",
          EquivIncome_Sample == "EquivIncome_T1[0.0-21600.0]" ~ "EquivIncome_T1min",
          EquivIncome_Sample == "EquivIncome_T2[21600.0-32000.0]" ~ "EquivIncome_T2medium",
          EquivIncome_Sample == "EquivIncome_T3[32000.0-56800480.0]" ~ "EquivIncome_T3max"),
        EquivIncome_Sample = factor(EquivIncome_Sample, levels = c("EquivIncome_T2medium",
                                                     "EquivIncome_T1min",
                                                     "EquivIncome_T3max", 
                                                     "missing"))) |> 
  select(lfd, EquivIncome_Sample) |> 
  right_join(w1p, by = "lfd")
    
  
w1p |> group_by(Sample) |> slice(1:5) |>  ungroup() |> select(lfd, Sample, contains("Income"))

w1p |> frq(EquivIncome_Sample, EquivIncome_sensan) # 1,366 and 3,765, respectively

```

```{r}
#|label: w1-build-speeding-variable
#|eval: true


w1_dur <- 
  w1_dur |> 
  left_join(w1p |> select(lfd, contains("Age_cat"), Sample)) |>
  # Step 1: set 0 to NA in all item columns
  mutate(across(ends_with("_dur"),
           ~ if_else(.x == 0, NA_real_, .x))
  )  |>
    
    
  group_by(Age_cat_sensan) |>
  # Step 2: compute medians (0/NA excluded)
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_dur"), 
           list(md = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), 
           .names = "{.col}_sensan_md")
  ) |>
  
  # Step 3: speeding indicators (_s) with group-specific medians
  # speeded: item answered in less than 40% of the age-group median time
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = ends_with("_dur"),
      .fns = ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA_real_,
        .x < 0.4 * get(paste0(cur_column(), "_sensan_md")) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_sensan_s"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  group_by(Age_cat_Sample) |>
  # Step 2: compute medians (0/NA excluded)
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_dur"), 
           list(md = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), 
           .names = "{.col}_Sample_md")
  ) |>
  
  # Step 3: speeding indicators (_s) with group-specific medians
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = ends_with("_dur"),
      .fns = ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA_real_,
        .x < 0.4 * get(paste0(cur_column(), "_Sample_md")) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_Sample_s"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  # Step 4: sum scores
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    Age_cat_sensan = if_else(
      is.na(Age_cat_sensan),
      factor("Age_T2[41.0-61.0]", levels = levels(Age_cat_sensan)),
      Age_cat_sensan), 
    
    Age_cat_Sample = if_else(
      Sample == "Sample" & is.na(Age_cat_Sample),
      factor("Age_T2[40.0-60.0]", levels = levels(Age_cat_Sample)),
      Age_cat_Sample),
    
    # number of items whose duration is < 0.4 * the item's median duration across all respondents in the same age group (can be 0 if the respondent did not speed on any item)
    ItemsSpeeded_sensan = sum(c_across(ends_with("_sensan_s")), na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalItems_sensan = sum(!is.na(c_across(ends_with("_sensan_s")))),
    ProportionSpeeding_sensan = ItemsSpeeded_sensan / TotalItems_sensan)


w1_dur <- 
  w1_dur |>
  filter(Sample == "Sample") |>
  
  mutate(
   
    ItemsSpeeded_Sample = sum(c_across(ends_with("_Sample_s")), na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalItems_Sample = sum(!is.na(c_across(ends_with("_Sample_s")))),
    ProportionSpeeding_Sample = ItemsSpeeded_Sample / TotalItems_Sample
  ) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  select(lfd, ItemsSpeeded_Sample, TotalItems_Sample, ProportionSpeeding_Sample) |> 
  right_join(w1_dur, by = "lfd")
# 
# w1_dur |> pull(TotalItems_Sample) |> summary()
#    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.    NA's 
#   130.0   146.0   148.0   150.2   154.0   191.0    2692 

w1_dur |> select(Sample, contains("pfrspcons07_du"), contains("Age_cat")) |> head(10) |> glimpse()


w1_dur |>
  select(ItemsSpeeded_sensan, TotalItems_sensan, ProportionSpeeding_sensan,
         ItemsSpeeded_Sample, TotalItems_Sample, ProportionSpeeding_Sample) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
      geom_histogram(fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef") +

 # geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Speeding Indicators (complete sample)")

w1_dur |>
  filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
  select(ItemsSpeeded_Sample, TotalItems_Sample, ProportionSpeeding_Sample) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
      geom_histogram(fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef") +

 # geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Speeding Indicators (analysis sample only)")

# Complete sample (sensitivity analysis only)
w1_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding_sensan>0.000) |> nrow()
w1_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding_sensan >0 & ProportionSpeeding_sensan<0.014388) |> pull(ItemsSpeeded_sensan) |> summary()  #1-2 Items - marginal

# upper median range
w1_dur |> filter(Sample == "Sample" & ProportionSpeeding_Sample>=0.013699) |> pull(ItemsSpeeded_Sample) |> summary()  #1-116 Items


#### TOP 10 MOST SPEEDED ITEMS

 # filter the _s columns
 s_sensan_cols <- w1_dur |> 
     select(ends_with("_sensan_s")) |>

 # compute column sums (number of 1s, ignoring NAs)
 w1_dur |>

   head(10)

 




w1_dur |> 
  #filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
  # with cutoff line
ggplot(aes(x = ProportionSpeeding_sensan)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, fill = "orange") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.014388, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +

       x = "Proportion Speeding", 
       y = "Density") +

w1_dur |> 
  #filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
  # with cutoff line
ggplot(aes(x = ProportionSpeeding_Sample, fill = Sample)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.013699, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.013699, y = 0, label = "Cutoff = 0.013699",

       x = "Proportion Speeding",

# consistent threshold: mean + 1 SD per group

thresholds_speeding_w1_sensan <- 
   w1_dur |>
   group_by(Age_cat_sensan) |> 
   summarise(
     thresh_Speed = mean(ProportionSpeeding_sensan, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(ProportionSpeeding_sensan, na.rm = TRUE),
     percentile_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding_sensan <= thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
     prop_above_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding_sensan > thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |> ungroup()

thresholds_speeding_w1_Sample <- 
   w1_dur |>
   group_by(Age_cat_Sample) |> 
   summarise(
     thresh_Speed = mean(ProportionSpeeding_Sample, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(ProportionSpeeding_Sample, na.rm = TRUE),
     percentile_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding_Sample <= thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
     prop_above_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding_Sample > thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |> ungroup()


w1_dur <- 
  w1_dur |> 
  mutate(
    Speeding_sensan = case_when(
      is.na(ProportionSpeeding_sensan) ~NA,
      Age_cat_sensan == "Age_T1[18.0-41.0]" & ProportionSpeeding_sensan > thresholds_speeding_w1_sensan |> filter(Age_cat_sensan == "Age_T1[18.0-41.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat_sensan == "Age_T2[41.0-61.0]" & ProportionSpeeding_sensan > thresholds_speeding_w1_sensan |> filter(Age_cat_sensan == "Age_T2[41.0-61.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat_sensan == "Age_T3[61.0-101.0]" & ProportionSpeeding_sensan > thresholds_speeding_w1_sensan |> filter(Age_cat_sensan == "Age_T3[61.0-101.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      TRUE ~"No speeding"
    ), 
    Speeding_sensan = factor(Speeding_sensan, levels = c("No speeding", "Speeding")),
    
    Speeding_Sample = case_when(
      is.na(ProportionSpeeding_Sample) ~NA,
      Age_cat_Sample == "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]" & ProportionSpeeding_Sample > thresholds_speeding_w1_Sample |> filter(Age_cat_Sample == "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat_Sample == "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]" & ProportionSpeeding_Sample > thresholds_speeding_w1_Sample |> filter(Age_cat_Sample == "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat_Sample == "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]" & ProportionSpeeding_Sample > thresholds_speeding_w1_Sample |> filter(Age_cat_Sample == "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      TRUE ~"No speeding"
    ), 
    Speeding_Sample = factor(Speeding_Sample, levels = c("No speeding", "Speeding"))
  ) 

w1_dur |> frq(Speeding_sensan, Speeding_Sample)


# join to w1p 
w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  left_join(
    w1_dur |> select(lfd, ProportionSpeeding_sensan, ProportionSpeeding_Sample, Speeding_sensan, Speeding_Sample), by = "lfd"
  )
```

##  w1 `FreeTextMis`, `Interviewmode`, `TargetGroup` 

```{r}
#| label: build-vars-Interviewmode,-Panelconsent,-TargetGroup
#| eval: true



FreeTextItems <- 
  
  w1p |> 

  select(
  pbirthmnth,
    pbirthyear_w1, 
    pcohabgebyear, 
    pothcount, 
    pgermstay,
    peduOthWhich,
    poccupation_isco08,
    plabincbrut, 
    plabincnet,
    psundvoteOthWhich,
    hhhsize,
    hhhage01,
    hhhage02,
  hhhincnet) |> colnames()


w1p <- 
  w1p |>   

  mutate(
    Interviewmode = case_when(
      qmethod == 3 ~ "PAPI",
      qmethod == 4 ~ "CAWI"
    ),
    Interviewmode = factor(Interviewmode, levels = c("PAPI", "CAWI")),
    
    
    TargetGroup = case_when(
      ZG == 1 ~ "Anchor",
      ZG == 2 ~ "HH member"
    ),
    TargetGroup = factor(TargetGroup, levels = c("Anchor", "HH member")),

    
    
    # apply standard missing codes to poccupation_isco08
    poccupation_isco08 = case_when(poccupation_isco08 == 0            ~ -2,
                                   poccupation_isco08 %in% c(8, 9)    ~ -1,
                                   TRUE                               ~ poccupation_isco08)) |> 
  
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(
    
    freetextmis = sum(across(all_of(FreeTextItems)) %in% c(-1, -9, -4), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    N_allFreeTitems = sum(across(all_of(FreeTextItems), ~!. %in% c(-2, -10)), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    FrTMisRatio = freetextmis/N_allFreeTitems) |> 
  
  ungroup() 
  

# more groups of Ratio Free text items missings not useful
w1p |> 
  reframe(Qu = quantile(FrTMisRatio, prob = c(0.33, 0.66), na.rm = TRUE))  





thresholds_FrTMis_w1_sensan <- 
   w1p |>
   group_by(Interviewmode) |> 
   summarise(
     thresh_FrTMis = mean(FrTMisRatio, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(FrTMisRatio, na.rm = TRUE),
     percentile_sp = mean(FrTMisRatio <= thresh_FrTMis, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
     prop_above_sp = mean(FrTMisRatio > thresh_FrTMis, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |> ungroup()

thresholds_FrTMis_w1_sensan 

thresholds_FrTMis_w1_Sample <- 
   w1p |>
   filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
   group_by(Interviewmode) |> 
   summarise(
     thresh_FrTMis = mean(FrTMisRatio, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(FrTMisRatio, na.rm = TRUE),
     percentile_sp = mean(FrTMisRatio <= thresh_FrTMis, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
     prop_above_sp = mean(FrTMisRatio > thresh_FrTMis, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |> ungroup()

thresholds_FrTMis_w1_Sample

w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  mutate(FrTMis_sensan = 
           case_when(
             is.na(FrTMisRatio) ~ "Not applicable",
             Interviewmode == "PAPI" & FrTMisRatio > thresholds_FrTMis_w1_sensan |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> pull(thresh_FrTMis) ~ "High",
             Interviewmode == "CAWI" & FrTMisRatio > thresholds_FrTMis_w1_sensan |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> pull(thresh_FrTMis) ~ "High",
```

## w1 Item Nonresponse
### Problem Vars only

- so-called `problem vars` have been detected manually and have a significantly different appearance between modes
- to be sure not to measure mere mode effects, these items are tested for significance in their nonresponse rate between modes
  - if significant difference => item is removed from df

```{r}
#| label: differences-for-problem.vars-w1


problem.vars <- c("pmigback01", "pmigback02",
          "hhhage03",
            "pworkexp01", "pworkexp02", "pworkexp03", "pworkexp04", "pworkexp05", "pworkexp06", 
            "pcohabgender", "pcohabgebyear", 
            "pothcount", "pnatoth")
w1p |> 
  select(lfd, Interviewmode,
         all_of(problem.vars)) |> #names()
 # select(all_of(mis_items_w1), Interviewmode) |> 
  group_by(Interviewmode) |> 
  summarise(across(pmigback01:pnatoth, 
                   ~ sum(.x %in% c(-1, -9), na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 
                   .names = "PropMiss_{.col}")) |> 
  pivot_longer(-Interviewmode, names_to = c("dummy", "Variable"), 
               names_pattern = "(PropMiss_)(.*)", values_to = "Prop") |> 
  select(-dummy) |> 
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = rev(unique(Variable)))) |>  

ggplot(aes(x = Variable, y = Prop, colour = Interviewmode, group = Interviewmode)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mode_palette) +
  labs(
    x = "Items",
    y = "Nonresponse Rate (Proportion)",
    colour = "Interviewmode",
    title = "Nonresponse Rate by Item and Mode"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: problem-vars-itemnonresponse


w1p |> 
 
    select(lfd, Interviewmode,
           all_of(problem.vars)) |>
  group_by(Interviewmode) |> 
  summarise(across(pmigback01:pnatoth, 
                   ~ sum(.x %in% c(-1, -9), na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 
                   .names = "PropMiss_{.col}")) 


# Absolute counts + N per group

counts <- w1p |>
  select(lfd, Interviewmode, all_of(problem.vars)) |>
  group_by(Interviewmode) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(all_of(problem.vars),
           ~ sum(.x %in% c(-1, -9), na.rm = TRUE),
           .names = "miss_{.col}")
  )

# Chi-square test per item
results <- map_dfr(problem.vars, function(var) {
  col <- paste0("miss_", var)
  
  miss  <- counts[[col]]        # c(n_miss_PAPI, n_miss_CAWI)
  n     <- counts$n             # c(n_PAPI, n_CAWI)
  notmiss <- n - miss
  
  mat <- matrix(c(miss, notmiss), nrow = 2,
                dimnames = list(c("PAPI", "CAWI"), c("Miss", "NotMiss")))
  
  # Fisher when expected cell counts < 5, otherwise chi-squared
  test <- if (any(chisq.test(mat)$expected < 5)) {
    fisher.test(mat)
  } else {
    chisq.test(mat, correct = FALSE)
  }
  
  tibble(
    Item       = var,
    p_value    = test$p.value,
    method     = test$method,
    prop_PAPI  = miss[1] / n[1],
    prop_CAWI  = miss[2] / n[2]
  )
}) |>
  mutate(
    p_adj      = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),  # Benjamini-Hochberg
    significant = p_adj < 0.05
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj)

print(results)


# all significant except pcohabgender and pcohabgebyear 


problem.vars <- c("pmigback01", "pmigback02",
          "hhhage03",
            "pworkexp01", "pworkexp02", "pworkexp03", "pworkexp04", "pworkexp05", "pworkexp06", 
           #"pcohabgender", "pcohabgebyear", 
            "pothcount", "pnatoth"
            )
```

## w1 Extreme/Middle

- 8 items with 5 level likert scales
- 8 items with 11 level likert scales



For comparison of extreme vs. middle response distributions by interviewmode see @fig-extrmintmodevioline 


```{r}
#| label: w1-Extreme-and-middle-items
#| eval: true






extrm5_items <- 
  w1p |> select(
    
    # 36 shared with `Nondiff`
    pcohes01:pcohes12,
    pfamexp01:pfamexp06,
    pworkexp01:pworkexp06,
    pneighexp01:pneighexp06,
    punivtrad01:punivtrad06,
    ppopul01:ppopul09,

    
    # 16    
    pcov01:pcov04, #5
    pdemocfit, #5
    pclimsor, #5
    pclimcon,  #5
    preldepriv #5
    
  ) |> colnames() #n = 53

extrm11_items <- 
  w1p |> select(
    
    # 28 shared with `Nondiff`
    pinsttrust01:pinsttrust11,
    pgrpsymp01:pgrpsymp17,
    
    plifeuse, #11
    plifesat, #11
    ppolatt,  #11
    pcovmeas, #11 
    pcovlim,   #11
    pgentrust, #11
    
    pdemocsat, #11
    
    pladder01 #11
   
  ) |> colnames() #n = 36


extrm7_items <- 
  w1p |> select(
    # 17 shared with `Nondiff`
    pgrpknow01:pgrpknow17
  ) |> colnames() #n = 17


t1 <- Sys.time()


w1p <- 
  w1p |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    
    # all extreme values on 5-likert
    E5 = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_items)) %in% c(1, 5), na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values on 5-likert
    M5 = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_items)) == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 5-likert
    EM.S5 = sum(E5, M5, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    
     # all extreme values on 7-likert
    E7 = sum(across(all_of(extrm7_items)) %in% c(1, 6), na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values on 7-likert
    M7 = sum(across(all_of(extrm7_items)) %in% c(7), na.rm = TRUE), # 7: "Don't know"
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 7-likert
    EM.S7 = sum(E7, M7, na.rm = TRUE),
     
    
    # all extreme values on 11-likert
    E11 = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_items)) %in% c(0, 10), na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values on 11-likert
    M11 = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_items)) %in% c(5), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 11-likert
    EM.S11 = sum(E11, M11, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    
    
    N5_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_items)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    N7_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm7_items)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    N11_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_items)) >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      
   
    
    # all extreme values
    E.S5S7S11 = sum(E5, E7, E11, na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values
    M.S5S7S11 = sum(M5, M7, M11, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all items responded 
    N_allExMidOpportunities = sum(N5_all, N7_all, N11_all),
    
    
    
    Ratio_Extr = ifelse(N_allExMidOpportunities == 0, NA, E.S5S7S11/N_allExMidOpportunities),
    Ratio_Mid = ifelse(N_allExMidOpportunities == 0, NA, M.S5S7S11/N_allExMidOpportunities),
    
    RatioExMid = sum(E.S5S7S11, M.S5S7S11, na.rm = TRUE)/N_allExMidOpportunities
    
  ) |> ungroup()

print(paste("Total duration (Extreme/Middle, mins):", as.numeric(Sys.time()-t1, "mins")))

cor.test(w1p$Ratio_Mid, w1p$Ratio_Extr) #-0.3700904, t = -51.83, df = 16927, p-value < 2.2e-16



#
```

## Categorize `Extr` & `Mid`


```{r}
#| label: w1-categorize-RatioExtreme-and-Mid
#| eval: true


thresholds_ExM_sensan <- 
  w1p |> 
  
  group_by(Interviewmode) |>
  summarise(
    thresh_Extr_Ratio = mean(Ratio_Extr, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(Ratio_Extr, na.rm = TRUE),
    thresh_Mid_Ratio = mean(Ratio_Mid, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(Ratio_Mid, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    percentile_Extr = mean(Ratio_Extr <= thresh_Extr_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percentile_Mid = mean(Ratio_Mid <= thresh_Mid_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    
    prop_above_Extr = mean(Ratio_Extr > thresh_Extr_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    prop_above_Mid = mean(Ratio_Mid > thresh_Mid_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )




thresholds_ExM_Sample <- 
  w1p |> 
  filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
  group_by(Interviewmode) |>
  summarise(
    thresh_Extr_Ratio = mean(Ratio_Extr, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(Ratio_Extr, na.rm = TRUE),
    thresh_Mid_Ratio = mean(Ratio_Mid, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(Ratio_Mid, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    percentile_Extr = mean(Ratio_Extr <= thresh_Extr_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percentile_Mid = mean(Ratio_Mid <= thresh_Mid_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    
    prop_above_Extr = mean(Ratio_Extr > thresh_Extr_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    prop_above_Mid = mean(Ratio_Mid > thresh_Mid_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )



w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  mutate(Extr_sensan = 
           case_when(
             is.na(Ratio_Extr) ~ "Not applicable",
             Interviewmode == "PAPI" & Ratio_Extr > thresholds_ExM_sensan |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> pull(thresh_Extr_Ratio) ~ "High",
             Interviewmode == "CAWI" & Ratio_Extr > thresholds_ExM_sensan |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> pull(thresh_Extr_Ratio) ~ "High",
             TRUE ~ "Not high"),
         Extr_sensan = factor(Extr_sensan, levels = c("Not high", "High", "Not applicable")),
         Mid_sensan = 
           case_when(
             is.na(Ratio_Mid) ~ "Not applicable",
             Interviewmode == "PAPI" & Ratio_Mid > thresholds_ExM_sensan |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> pull(thresh_Mid_Ratio) ~ "High",
             Interviewmode == "CAWI" & Ratio_Mid > thresholds_ExM_sensan |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> pull(thresh_Mid_Ratio) ~ "High",
             TRUE ~ "Not high"),
         
         Mid_sensan = factor(Mid_sensan, levels = c("Not high", "High", "Not applicable")))


w1p <- 
  w1p |> 
  mutate(Extr_Sample = 
           case_when(
             Sample == "sensan" ~NA, 
             is.na(Ratio_Extr) ~ "Not applicable",
             Interviewmode == "PAPI" & Ratio_Extr > thresholds_ExM_Sample |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> pull(thresh_Extr_Ratio) ~ "High",
             Interviewmode == "CAWI" & Ratio_Extr > thresholds_ExM_Sample |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> pull(thresh_Extr_Ratio) ~ "High",
             TRUE ~ "Not high"),
         Extr_Sample = factor(Extr_Sample, levels = c("Not high", "High", "Not applicable")),
         
         Mid_Sample = 
           case_when(
             Sample == "sensan" ~NA, 
             is.na(Ratio_Mid) ~ "Not applicable",
             Interviewmode == "PAPI" & Ratio_Mid > thresholds_ExM_Sample |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> pull(thresh_Mid_Ratio) ~ "High",
             Interviewmode == "CAWI" & Ratio_Mid > thresholds_ExM_Sample |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> pull(thresh_Mid_Ratio) ~ "High",
             TRUE ~ "Not high"),
         Mid_Sample = factor(Mid_Sample, levels = c("Not high", "High", "Not applicable"))) |> 
  select(lfd, Extr_Sample, Mid_Sample) |> 
  right_join(w1p, by = "lfd")



w1p |> filter(!(is.na(Extr_Sample) & is.na(Mid_Sample))) |> count(Extr_Sample, Mid_Sample)
```

In Wave 1, anchor persons and household members were asked to respond to 52 questions. The question for panelconsent, the household panel (only for anker persons) and the questions for the device used followed (CAWI only). 
From question number 34, all questions were demography. The only exception made question number 47 (psunvote).


We calculated the level on nondifferentiations for a variety of questions that were presented in the form of 10 item grids from the whole survey namely questions 1, 14, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 30 and 31.
The scales include a total of 97 items.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-show: hold


chart.Correlation(w1 |> select(contains("MeanRootPairs")), histogram = TRUE)

```

### w1 Nd SEM using CT-C(M − 1) Model



- Ideally, the latent scores would be used. However, they can only be estimated for records with complete MeanRootPairs values, which would entail a very high amount of missingness.
- We therefore use the manifest scores, aggregated as the mean across all MeanRootPairs values (=> almost no missingness), and then check the agreement between the two measures.
- The latent scores correlate with the aggregated manifest scores at .86*** (WK) and .82*** (ST), respectively

```{r}
#| label: Wave-1-nd-latent-classes-sensan
#| eval: true
#| include: true

p_load("lavaan", "tidySEM", "semPlot")


# correlated traits: WK (weak) and ST (strong)
# correlated methods-1: Reference-scale: 11-likert

w1LatND_mod <- "

#NondiffWeak
WK =~
MeanRootPairs_pinsttrust + MeanRootPairs_pfrspcons + MeanRootPairs_ppopul + MeanRootPairs_pgrpsymp 

#NonidffStrong
ST =~ 
MeanRootPairs_pcohes + MeanRootPairs_pfamexp + MeanRootPairs_pworkexp + MeanRootPairs_pneighexp + MeanRootPairs_punivtrad + MeanRootPairs_pgrpknow

#grids with scales with less-than-11-point-likert scales 
u11_sensan =~ 
MeanRootPairs_pcohes + MeanRootPairs_pfamexp + MeanRootPairs_pworkexp + MeanRootPairs_pneighexp + MeanRootPairs_punivtrad + MeanRootPairs_ppopul + MeanRootPairs_pfrspcons + MeanRootPairs_pgrpknow 

WK ~~ 0 * u11_sensan
ST ~~ 0 * u11_sensan

"

# simple model without groups
w1LatND_fit_sensan <- sem(w1LatND_mod, w1, meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(w1LatND_fit_sensan, fit = TRUE)

fscores <- lavPredict(w1LatND_fit_sensan)  # matrix, not a list
idx     <- lavInspect(w1LatND_fit_sensan, "case.idx")  # single vector

# merge the scores back in, following the lavaan documentation for single-group models:
for (fs in colnames(fscores)) {
  w1[idx, fs] <- fscores[, fs]
}

# rename to wave suffix (latent scores WK/ST are not carried on)
w1 <- 
  w1 |> 
  rename_with(
    ~ str_c(., "_sensan"),
    starts_with("MeanRootPairs_"),
    c(WK, ST)
  ) |> select(-starts_with("temp_"), -u11_sensan)

w1 |> names()

```


```{r}
#| label: calculate-nondiff-wave-1-Sample
#| eval: true

w1s <- w1 |> filter(Sample == "Sample") |> select(c("lfd", "Extr_Sample":"Mid_sensan"))

pcohes.items <- w1s|> select(pcohes01:pcohes12) |> colnames()
pinsttrust.items <- w1s|> select(pinsttrust01:pinsttrust11) |> colnames()
pfamexp.items <- w1s|> select(pfamexp01:pfamexp06) |> colnames()
pworkexp.items <- w1s|> select(pworkexp01:pworkexp06) |> colnames()    # Category "Unemployed"
pneighexp.items <- w1s|> select(pneighexp01:pneighexp06) |> colnames()
punivtrad.items <- w1s|> select(punivtrad01:punivtrad06) |> colnames()
pgrpsymp.items <- w1s|> select(pgrpsymp01:pgrpsymp17) |> colnames()
pgrpknow.items <- w1s|> select(pgrpknow01:pgrpknow17) |> colnames()
pfrspcons.items <- w1s|> select(pfrspcons01:pfrspcons07) |> colnames()
ppopul.items <- w1s|> select(ppopul01:ppopul09) |> colnames()

items_list <- list(pcohes.items, pinsttrust.items,
                   pfamexp.items, pworkexp.items, 
                   pneighexp.items, punivtrad.items, pgrpsymp.items, 
                   pgrpknow.items, pfrspcons.items, ppopul.items)

tND <- Sys.time()

# extract all items from items_list
all_items <- unlist(items_list)

w1s_papi <- 
  w1s|> 
  filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> 
  select(lfd, all_of(all_items)) |>  # select only the item columns
  meanRootPairs(items_list) |> 
  ungroup()

w1s_cawi  <- 
  w1s|> 
  filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> 
  select(lfd, all_of(all_items)) |> 
   meanRootPairs(items_list) |> ungroup()


# merge PAPI and CAWI
w1s_meanroot <- bind_rows(w1s_papi, w1s_cawi) |> select(lfd, starts_with("temp_"), starts_with("MeanRoot"))

# join onto the original w1s dataset
w1s<- w1s|> 
  left_join(w1s_meanroot, by = "lfd")
```

```{r}
#| label: Wave-1-nd-latent-classes-Sample

#| include: true



# correlated traits: WK (weak) and ST (strong)
# correlated methods-1: Reference-scale: 11-likert

w1sLatND_mod <- "

#NondiffWeak
WK =~
MeanRootPairs_pinsttrust + MeanRootPairs_pfrspcons + MeanRootPairs_ppopul + MeanRootPairs_pgrpsymp 

#NonidffStrong
ST =~ 
MeanRootPairs_pcohes + MeanRootPairs_pfamexp + MeanRootPairs_pworkexp + MeanRootPairs_pneighexp + MeanRootPairs_punivtrad + MeanRootPairs_pgrpknow

#grids with scales with less-than-11-point-likert scales 
u11 =~ 
MeanRootPairs_pcohes + MeanRootPairs_pfamexp + MeanRootPairs_pworkexp + MeanRootPairs_pneighexp + MeanRootPairs_punivtrad + MeanRootPairs_ppopul + MeanRootPairs_pfrspcons + MeanRootPairs_pgrpknow 

WK ~~ 0 * u11
ST ~~ 0 * u11

"

# simple model without groups
w1sLatND_fit <- sem(w1sLatND_mod, w1s, meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(w1sLatND_fit, fit = TRUE)
fscores <- lavPredict(w1sLatND_fit)  # matrix, not a list
idx     <- lavInspect(w1sLatND_fit, "case.idx")  # single vector

# merge the scores back in, following the lavaan documentation for single-group models:
for (fs in colnames(fscores)) {
  w1s[idx, fs] <- fscores[, fs]
}
```

```{r}
# model used as the basis for the coefficient table
SEM_w1 <- table_results(w1sLatND_fit)|>
    mutate(label = label |>
               str_replace("MeanRootPairs_", "Mrp.") |>
               str_replace("=~", ".BY.") |>
               str_replace("~~", ".WITH.") |>
               str_replace("~1", "") |>
               str_replace("^\\.", "Means.")) |>
  filter(!str_starts(label, "Variances"),
         !str_starts(label, "Means")) |> 
  select(label, est_sig, se, confint) 


SEM_w1|> 
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    col.names = c("Label",
                  "Est.", "SE", "95\\% CI"),
    escape = FALSE
  )
```

# w2 Build `Speeding`
See fig-w1p2Speedingcategorization

```{r}
#| label: fig-w1p2Speedingcategorization
#| fig-show: hold
#| fig-cap: Speeding at w2
#| include: true
#| eval: true
#| fig-height: 4




w2 |> 
  filter(qmethod == 4) |> 
  select(lfd, BreakOff, interviewdauer) |> 
  #left_join(w2_dur, by = "lfd") |> 
  left_join(w1 |> select(lfd, Age_cat = Age_cat_Sample), by = "lfd") |> 
  
  #select(-plifesat03_dur, -plifesat04_dur, -plifesat10_dur, -contains("prelfund")) |> 


  mutate(
   

    # not include into calculation of quantile borders: N = 54 Break-off cases
    # not include into calculation of quantile borders: N = 54 Break-off cases
  interviewdauer = case_when(BreakOff == "Break-off" ~ NA, 
                             TRUE ~ interviewdauer)) |> 
  
  group_by(Age_cat) |> 


  summarise(
    `1` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    `3` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.03, na.rm = TRUE),
    `5` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    `10` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `15` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.15, na.rm = TRUE),
    `20` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE),
    `25` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    `33` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.33, na.rm = TRUE),
    `50` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    `66` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.66, na.rm = TRUE), 
    `70` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE),
    `75` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    `80` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    `85` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE),
    `95` = quantile(interviewdauer, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  gather(key = "Quantile", value = "Value", -Age_cat) |> 
  mutate(Quantile = as.numeric(Quantile)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = Quantile, 
             x = Value, color = Age_cat)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,100, by = 5)) +
  labs(x = "Interview duration", y = "Quantile",
       title = "w2: Quantiles of interview duration per age group") +
  papaja::theme_apa()
  
```

```{r}
#|eval: true


w2_dur <- 
  w2_dur |> 
  left_join(w1 |> select(lfd, Age_cat = Age_cat_Sample)) |>
    #inner_join(w2_lfds, by = "lfd") |>
  # Step 1: set 0 to NA in all item columns
  mutate(across(ends_with("_dur"),
           ~ if_else(.x == 0, NA_real_, .x))
  )  |> 
    
    # -110 cases not in the analysis sample due to age inconsistency (100) or w1-only participation (10)
    filter(!is.na(Age_cat)) |> 
    
    
  group_by(Age_cat) |>
  # Step 2: compute medians (0/NA excluded)
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_dur"), 
           list(md = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), 
           .names = "{.col}_md")
  ) |>
  
  # Step 3: speeding indicators (_s) with group-specific medians
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = ends_with("_dur"),
      .fns = ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA_real_,
        .x < 0.4 * get(paste0(cur_column(), "_md")) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_s"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  # Step 4: sum scores
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    
    # number of items whose duration is < 0.4 * the item's median duration across all respondents in the same age group (can be 0 if the respondent did not speed on any item)
    ItemsSpeeded = sum(c_across(ends_with("_s")), na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalItems = sum(!is.na(c_across(ends_with("_s")))),
    ProportionSpeeding = ItemsSpeeded / TotalItems)|>
  ungroup() 



w2_dur |>
  select(ItemsSpeeded, TotalItems, ProportionSpeeding) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
      geom_histogram(fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef") +

 # geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Speeding Indicators (w2)")



# Complete sample (sensitivity analysis only)
w2_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding>0.000) |> nrow()
w2_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding >0 & ProportionSpeeding<0.014286) |> pull(ItemsSpeeded) |> summary()  #1-3 Items - marginal

# upper median range: 
w2_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding>=0.014286) |> pull(ItemsSpeeded) |> summary()  #1-186 Items

w2_dur |>

ggplot(aes(x = ProportionSpeeding)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, fill = "orange") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.014286, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +

# consistent threshold: mean + 1 SD per group
 
thresholds_speeding_w2 <- 
   w2_dur |>
   group_by(Age_cat) |> 
   summarise(
     thresh_Speed = mean(ProportionSpeeding, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(ProportionSpeeding, na.rm = TRUE),
     percentile_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding <= thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
     prop_above_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding > thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |> ungroup()

w2_dur <- 
  w2_dur |> 
  mutate(
    Speeding = case_when(
      is.na(ProportionSpeeding) ~NA,
      Age_cat == "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]" & ProportionSpeeding > thresholds_speeding_w2 |> filter(Age_cat == "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat == "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]" & ProportionSpeeding > thresholds_speeding_w2 |> filter(Age_cat == "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat == "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]" & ProportionSpeeding > thresholds_speeding_w2 |> filter(Age_cat == "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      TRUE ~"No speeding"
    ), 
    Speeding = factor(Speeding, levels = c("No speeding", "Speeding"))
  )

 
 
 
 

# join to w2 
w2 <-
```

```{r}
#| label: problem-vars-itemnonresponse-w2



w2 |> 
    select(lfd, Interviewmode,
           all_of(problem.vars)) |>
  group_by(Interviewmode) |> 
  summarise(across(plifesat03:pdiscrimoth, 
                   ~ sum(.x %in% c(-1, -9), na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 
                   .names = "PropMiss_{.col}")) 


# Absolute counts + N per group
counts <- w2 |>
  select(lfd, Interviewmode, all_of(problem.vars)) |>
  group_by(Interviewmode) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(all_of(problem.vars),
           ~ sum(.x %in% c(-1, -9), na.rm = TRUE),
           .names = "miss_{.col}")
  )

# Chi-square test per item
results <- map_dfr(problem.vars, function(var) {
  col <- paste0("miss_", var)
  
  miss  <- counts[[col]]        # c(n_miss_PAPI, n_miss_CAWI)
  n     <- counts$n             # c(n_PAPI, n_CAWI)
  notmiss <- n - miss
  
  mat <- matrix(c(miss, notmiss), nrow = 2,
                dimnames = list(c("PAPI", "CAWI"), c("Miss", "NotMiss")))
  
  # Fisher when expected cell counts < 5, otherwise chi-squared
  test <- if (any(chisq.test(mat)$expected < 5)) {
    fisher.test(mat)
  } else {
    chisq.test(mat, correct = FALSE)
  }
  
  tibble(
    Item       = var,
    p_value    = test$p.value,
    method     = test$method,
    prop_PAPI  = miss[1] / n[1],
    prop_CAWI  = miss[2] / n[2]
  )
}) |>
  mutate(
    p_adj      = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),  # Benjamini-Hochberg
    significant = p_adj < 0.05
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj)

print(results)


# all significant except "prelfund04"
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    
    # all extreme values on 5-likert
    E5 = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_items)) %in% c(1, 5), na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values on 5-likert
    M5 = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_items)) == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 5-likert
    EM.S5 = sum(E5, M5, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    
     # all extreme values on 6-likert
    E6 = sum(across(all_of(extrm6_items)) %in% c(1, 6), na.rm = TRUE),
    # no middle category
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 6-likert: see E6
  
     
    
    # all extreme values on 11-likert
    E11 = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_items)) %in% c(0, 10), na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values on 11-likert
    M11 = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_items)) %in% c(5), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 11-likert
    EM.S11 = sum(E11, M11, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    
    
    N5_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_items)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    N6_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm6_items)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    N11_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_items)) >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      
   
    
    # all extreme values
    E.S5S6S11 = sum(E5, E6, E11, na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values (there are no M6)
    M.S5S11 = sum(M5, M11, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all items responded 
    N_allExMidOpportunities = sum(N5_all, N6_all, N11_all),
    
    # proportion of extreme and middle values on 5-likert by all responses
    Ratio_S5 = ifelse(N5_all == 0, NA, EM.S5/N5_all),
    # proportion of extreme and middle values on 6-likert by all responses
    Ratio_S6 = ifelse(N6_all == 0, NA, E6/N6_all),
    # proportion of extreme and middle values on 11-likert by all responses
    Ratio_S11 = ifelse(N11_all == 0, NA, EM.S11/N11_all),
    
    
    Ratio_Extr = ifelse(N_allExMidOpportunities == 0, NA, E.S5S6S11/N_allExMidOpportunities),
    Ratio_Mid = ifelse(N_allExMidOpportunities == 0, NA, M.S5S11/N_allExMidOpportunities),
    
    RatioExMid = sum(E.S5S6S11, M.S5S11, na.rm = TRUE)/N_allExMidOpportunities
    
  ) |> ungroup()

print(paste("Total duration (Extreme/Middle, mins):", as.numeric(Sys.time()-t1, "mins")))


cor.test(w2$Ratio_Mid, w2$Ratio_Extr)

```


## w2 Categorize `Extr` & `Mid`




```{r}
#| label: w2-categorize-Extr-Mid


thresholds_ExM <- 
  w2 |> 
  
  group_by(Interviewmode) |>
  summarise(
    thresh_Extr_Ratio = mean(Ratio_Extr, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(Ratio_Extr, na.rm = TRUE),
    thresh_Mid_Ratio = mean(Ratio_Mid, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(Ratio_Mid, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    percentile_Extr = mean(Ratio_Extr <= thresh_Extr_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percentile_Mid = mean(Ratio_Mid <= thresh_Mid_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    
    prop_above_Extr = mean(Ratio_Extr > thresh_Extr_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    prop_above_Mid = mean(Ratio_Mid > thresh_Mid_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )

w2 <- 
  w2 |> 
  mutate(Extr = 
           case_when(
             is.na(Ratio_Extr) ~ "Not applicable",
             Interviewmode == "PAPI" & Ratio_Extr > thresholds_ExM |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> pull(thresh_Extr_Ratio) ~ "High",
             Interviewmode == "CAWI" & Ratio_Extr > thresholds_ExM |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> pull(thresh_Extr_Ratio) ~ "High",
             TRUE ~ "Not high"),
         Extr = factor(Extr, levels = c("Not high", "High", "Not applicable")),
         Mid = 
           case_when(
             is.na(Ratio_Mid) ~ "Not applicable",
             Interviewmode == "PAPI" & Ratio_Mid > thresholds_ExM |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> pull(thresh_Mid_Ratio) ~ "High",
             Interviewmode == "CAWI" & Ratio_Mid > thresholds_ExM |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> pull(thresh_Mid_Ratio) ~ "High",
             TRUE ~ "Not high"),
         
         Mid = factor(Mid, levels = c("Not high", "High", "Not applicable")))


w2 |> count(Interviewmode, Extr); w2 |> count(Interviewmode, Mid)
```

### w2 Nd SEM using CT-C(M-1) Model




```{r}
#| label: w2-SEM
#| eval: true
#| include: true

# correlated traits: WK (weak), ST (strong), Biographical (BIO)
# correlated methods-1: Reference-Scale: 11-likert
w2LatND_mod <- "

WK =~
MeanRootPairs_plifesat +  MeanRootPairs_pglob  + MeanRootPairs_pedugoal +   MeanRootPairs_pgender + MeanRootPairs_pauthor + MeanRootPairs_pactivity + MeanRootPairs_pnarcism + MeanRootPairs_pdiscrim + MeanRootPairs_pinform 


ST =~ 
 MeanRootPairs_psocdes + MeanRootPairs_pschwartz + MeanRootPairs_ppertrust 


BIO =~
MeanRootPairs_pfathbeh + MeanRootPairs_pmothbeh

#grids with scales with less-than-11-point-likert scales
u11 =~ 
MeanRootPairs_pinform + MeanRootPairs_pedugoal + MeanRootPairs_pfathbeh + MeanRootPairs_pmothbeh + MeanRootPairs_psocdes + MeanRootPairs_pschwartz + MeanRootPairs_pnarcism + MeanRootPairs_pdiscrim + MeanRootPairs_pgender + MeanRootPairs_pauthor + MeanRootPairs_pactivity 

BIO ~~ 0 * u11
WK ~~ 0 * u11
ST ~~ 0 * u11

"


# simple model without groups
w2LatND_fit <- sem(w2LatND_mod, w2, meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(w2LatND_fit, fit = TRUE)
fscores <- lavPredict(w2LatND_fit)  # matrix, not a list
idx     <- lavInspect(w2LatND_fit, "case.idx")  # single vector

# merge the scores back in, following the lavaan documentation for single-group models:
for (fs in colnames(fscores)) {
  w2[idx, fs] <- fscores[, fs]
}



```




```{r}



# model used as the basis for the coefficient table
SEM_w2 <- table_results(w2LatND_fit)|>
    mutate(label = label |>
               str_replace("MeanRootPairs_", "Mrp.") |>
               str_replace("=~", ".BY.") |>
               str_replace("~~", ".WITH.") |>
               str_replace("~1", "") |>
               str_replace("^\\.", "Means.")) |>
  
  filter(!str_starts(label, "Variances"),
         !str_starts(label, "Means")) |>

SEM_w2|>

    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = 3,
    col.names = c("Label",
                  "Est.", "SE", "95\\% CI"),

  )
```

```{r}
#|label: w3-build-speeding-variable
#|eval: true


w3_dur <- 
  w3_dur |> 
  left_join(w1 |> select(pid, Age_cat = Age_cat_Sample), by = "pid") |> 
   
    #inner_join(w3_lfds, by = "lfd") |>
  # Step 1: set 0 to NA in all item columns
  mutate(across(ends_with("_dur"),
           ~ if_else(.x == 0, NA_real_, .x))
  )  |> 
    
    # -0 cases not in the analysis sample due to age inconsistency (0) or w1/w2-only participation (0)
    filter(!is.na(Age_cat)) |> 
    
    
  group_by(Age_cat) |>
  # Step 2: compute medians (0/NA excluded)
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_dur"), 
           list(md = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), 
           .names = "{.col}_md")
  ) |>
  
  # Step 3: speeding indicators (_s) with group-specific medians
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = ends_with("_dur"),
      .fns = ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA_real_,
        .x < 0.4 * get(paste0(cur_column(), "_md")) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_s"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  # Step 4: sum scores
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    
    # number of items whose duration is < 0.4 * the item's median duration across all respondents in the same age group (can be 0 if the respondent did not speed on any item)
    ItemsSpeeded = sum(c_across(ends_with("_s")), na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalItems = sum(!is.na(c_across(ends_with("_s")))),
    ProportionSpeeding = ItemsSpeeded / TotalItems)|>
  ungroup() 

  



w3_dur |>
  select(ItemsSpeeded, TotalItems, ProportionSpeeding) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
      geom_histogram(fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef") +

 # geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Speeding Indicators (w3)")



# Complete sample (sensitivity analysis only)
w3_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding>0.000) |> nrow()
w3_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding >0 & ProportionSpeeding<0.019324) |> pull(ItemsSpeeded) |> summary()  #1-4 Items - marginal

# upper median range: 
w3_dur |> filter(ProportionSpeeding>=0.019324) |> pull(ItemsSpeeded) |> summary()  #1-193 Items

#### TOP 10 MOST SPEEDED ITEMS

 # filter the _s columns
 s_cols <- w3_dur |> 
     select(ends_with("_s")) |> 
     names()
 
 # compute column sums (number of 1s, ignoring NAs)
 w3_dur |> 
     summarise(across(all_of(s_cols), ~ sum(.x == 1, na.rm = TRUE))) |> 
     pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "sum_1er") |> 
     arrange(desc(sum_1er)) |> 
   head(10)
 

# pweathev03_dur_s	652			
# ptaxparty06_dur_s	617			
# pedu02_dur_s	613			
# pweathev02_dur_s	589			
# ptaxparty02_dur_s	582			
# pladder01_dur_s	576			
# ptaxego_dur_s	545			
# pcoleffic02_dur_s	544			
# pweathev01_dur_s	538			
# pgendego_dur_s	503	

 

 
 
# consistent threshold: mean + 1 SD per group
 
thresholds_speeding_w3 <- 
   w3_dur |>
   group_by(Age_cat) |> 
   summarise(
     thresh_Speed = mean(ProportionSpeeding, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(ProportionSpeeding, na.rm = TRUE),
     percentile_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding <= thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
     prop_above_sp = mean(ProportionSpeeding > thresh_Speed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |> ungroup()

w3_dur <- 
  w3_dur |> 
  mutate(
    Speeding = case_when(
      is.na(ProportionSpeeding) ~NA,
      Age_cat == "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]" & ProportionSpeeding > thresholds_speeding_w3 |> filter(Age_cat == "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat == "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]" & ProportionSpeeding > thresholds_speeding_w3 |> filter(Age_cat == "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      Age_cat == "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]" & ProportionSpeeding > thresholds_speeding_w3 |> filter(Age_cat == "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]") |> pull(thresh_Speed) ~ "Speeding",
      TRUE ~"No speeding"
    ), 
    Speeding = factor(Speeding, levels = c("No speeding", "Speeding"))
  )

w3_dur |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ProportionSpeeding)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, fill = "orange") +
  geom_vline(data = thresholds_speeding_w3,
             aes(xintercept = thresh_Speed),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = thresholds_speeding_w3,
            aes(x = thresh_Speed, y = 0,
                label = paste0("cutoff = ", round(thresh_Speed, 4))),
            hjust = -0.1, vjust = -1, color = "red", size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Age_cat) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Proportion Speeding by age group (w3)",
       subtitle = "dashed line: group-specific mean + 1 SD cutoff",
       x = "Proportion Speeding",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()






# join to w3 
w3 <- 
  w3 |> 
  left_join(
    w3_dur |> select(pid, ProportionSpeeding, Speeding), by = "pid"
  )
```

```{r}
    pclimattit01:pclimattit06,
    pcliminfra01:pcliminfra05,
    ppopul10:ppopul15,

    prefmove01:prefmove06,
    psubjhealth,

  ) |> colnames()

#54
extrm11_itemsw3 <- 
  w3 |> select(

    pweathev01:pweathev03,
    pundesinfra1,
    pimmego, 
    ptaxego, 
    pclimego,
    pgendego,
    plifesat,
   
    # shared with nondiff:
    pladder01:pladder05,
    pconcern01:pconcern12,
    pimmparty01:pimmparty07,
    ptaxparty01:ptaxparty07,
    pclimparty01:pclimparty07,
    pgendparty01:pgendparty07
    
  ) |> colnames()



 

t1 <- Sys.time()


w3 <- 
  w3 |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    
    # all extreme values on 5-likert
    E5 = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_itemsw3)) %in% c(1, 5), na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values on 5-likert
    M5 = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_itemsw3)) == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 5-likert
    EM.S5 = sum(E5, M5, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    
    
    # all extreme values on 11-likert
    E11 = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_itemsw3)) %in% c(0, 10), na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values on 11-likert
    M11 = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_itemsw3)) %in% c(5), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all extreme and middle values on 11-likert
    EM.S11 = sum(E11, M11, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    
    
    N5_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm5_itemsw3)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    N11_all = sum(across(all_of(extrm11_itemsw3)) >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      
   
    
    # all extreme values
    E.S5S11 = sum(E5, E11, na.rm = TRUE),
    # all middle values
    M.S5S11 = sum(M5, M11, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # all items responded 
    N_allExMidOpportunities = sum(N5_all, N11_all),
    
    # proportion of extreme and middle values on 5-likert by all responses
    Ratio_S5 = ifelse(N5_all == 0, NA, EM.S5/N5_all),
    
    # proportion of extreme and middle values on 11-likert by all responses
    Ratio_S11 = ifelse(N11_all == 0, NA, EM.S11/N11_all),
    
    
    Ratio_Extr = ifelse(N_allExMidOpportunities == 0, NA, E.S5S11/N_allExMidOpportunities),
    Ratio_Mid = ifelse(N_allExMidOpportunities == 0, NA, M.S5S11/N_allExMidOpportunities),
    
    RatioExMid = sum(E.S5S11, M.S5S11, na.rm = TRUE)/N_allExMidOpportunities
    
  ) |> ungroup()

print(paste("Total duration (Extreme/Middle, mins):", as.numeric(Sys.time()-t1, "mins")))

cor.test(w3$Ratio_Mid, w3$Ratio_Extr)

```

```{r}
#| label: problem-vars-itemnonresponse-w3



w3 |> 
    select(pid, Interviewmode,
           all_of(problem.vars)) |>
  group_by(Interviewmode) |> 
  summarise(across(pmember11:hhhage03, 
                   ~ sum(.x %in% c(-1, -9), na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 
                   .names = "PropMiss_{.col}")) 


# Absolute counts + N per group
counts <- w3 |>
  select(pid, Interviewmode, all_of(problem.vars)) |>
  group_by(Interviewmode) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(all_of(problem.vars),
           ~ sum(.x %in% c(-1, -9), na.rm = TRUE),
           .names = "miss_{.col}")
  )

# Chi-square test per item
results <- map_dfr(problem.vars, function(var) {
  col <- paste0("miss_", var)
  
  miss  <- counts[[col]]        # c(n_miss_PAPI, n_miss_CAWI)
  n     <- counts$n             # c(n_PAPI, n_CAWI)
  notmiss <- n - miss
  
  mat <- matrix(c(miss, notmiss), nrow = 2,
                dimnames = list(c("PAPI", "CAWI"), c("Miss", "NotMiss")))
  
  # Fisher when expected cell counts < 5, otherwise chi-squared
  test <- if (any(chisq.test(mat)$expected < 5)) {
    fisher.test(mat)
  } else {
    chisq.test(mat, correct = FALSE)
  }
  
  tibble(
    Item       = var,
    p_value    = test$p.value,
    method     = test$method,
    prop_PAPI  = miss[1] / n[1],
    prop_CAWI  = miss[2] / n[2]
  )
}) |>
  mutate(
    p_adj      = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),  # Benjamini-Hochberg
    significant = p_adj < 0.05
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj)

print(results)


# all significant => problem_vars remain unchanged

```

```{r}
    hhhage03_mod = as.double(hhhage03), 
     
     hhhage03_mod = case_when(
       
       
       #if number of children > 14 > 0, no need to check hhhage03 
       hhhage02 > 0 ~ 0, #& hhhage03_mod < 0 ~ 0,
     #  hhhage02 == -2 ~ -2,
       
       TRUE ~ hhhage03_mod),
       
                            
                            
        pnoincsource = case_when(
      # if any of the pincsource items are selected, there'd be no reason to check the box
    (pincsource01 == 1 | pincsource02 == 1 | pincsource03 == 1 | pincsource04 == 1 | pincsource05 == 1 | pincsource06 == 1) & Interviewmode == "PAPI" ~ 0, 
    TRUE ~ pnoincsource
  ))  |> 
  
   # for all "pincsource"-items: 
  mutate(across(starts_with("pincsource"), 
                
                ~ case_when(
                  
                  # if all items are missing and pnoincsource is also missing, treat it as missing
                  all(c_across(pincsource01:pincsource06) %in% c(-1, -9) & pnoincsource %in% c(-1, -9)) ~ -1,
```

### w3 Nd SEM using CT-C(M-1) Model



```{r}
#| label: w3-SEM
#| eval: true
#| include: true

# correlated traits: WK (weak), ST (strong), Selfexperienced (SE)
# correlated methods-1: Reference-Scale: 11-likert
w3LatND_mod <- "


WK =~
MeanRootPairs_puss + MeanRootPairs_pconcern + MeanRootPairs_pconsp + MeanRootPairs_pgendeq + MeanRootPairs_pregident + MeanRootPairs_pinfrasat + MeanRootPairs_pcliminfra + MeanRootPairs_ppopul 


ST =~ 
 MeanRootPairs_pbsjo + MeanRootPairs_pbsjperc + MeanRootPairs_pladder + MeanRootPairs_pclimattit + MeanRootPairs_pantisem + MeanRootPairs_prefmove + MeanRootPairs_pimmparty + MeanRootPairs_ptaxparty + MeanRootPairs_pclimparty + MeanRootPairs_pgendparty


# nondiff for scales with fewer than 11 Likert points
u11 =~ 
MeanRootPairs_pbsjo + MeanRootPairs_pbsjperc + MeanRootPairs_puss + MeanRootPairs_pconsp + MeanRootPairs_pgendeq + MeanRootPairs_pregident + MeanRootPairs_pinfrasat +  MeanRootPairs_pclimattit + MeanRootPairs_pcliminfra + MeanRootPairs_ppopul + MeanRootPairs_pantisem + MeanRootPairs_prefmove




WK ~~ 0 * u11
ST ~~ 0 * u11"

# simple model without groups
w3LatND_fit <- sem(w3LatND_mod, w3, meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(w3LatND_fit, fit = TRUE)


fscores <- lavPredict(w3LatND_fit)  # matrix, not a list
idx     <- lavInspect(w3LatND_fit, "case.idx")  # single vector

# merge the scores back in, following the lavaan documentation for single-group models:
for (fs in colnames(fscores)) {
  w3[idx, fs] <- fscores[, fs]
}


```

# Categorize Nondiff

```{r}
nondiff_ratio <- function(data, item_cols, mode_var,
                          subgroup_var = NULL, subgroup_val = NULL) {
  
  ref_data <- if (!is.null(subgroup_var)) {
    data |> filter(.data[[subgroup_var]] == subgroup_val)
  } else data
  
  p66_by_mode <- ref_data |>
    group_by(.data[[mode_var]]) |>
    summarise(across(all_of(item_cols),
                     ~ quantile(.x, 0.66, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .names = "p66_{.col}"),
              .groups = "drop")
  
  p66_cols <- paste0("p66_", item_cols)
  
  # Explicit filter before pipeline — avoids '.' placeholder issue
  working_data <- if (!is.null(subgroup_var)) {
    data |> filter(.data[[subgroup_var]] == subgroup_val)
  } else data
  
  working_data |>
    left_join(p66_by_mode, by = mode_var) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      n_high  = sum(c_across(all_of(item_cols)) > c_across(all_of(p66_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_valid = sum(!is.na(c_across(all_of(item_cols)))),
      ratio   = case_when(          # <- these three lines replace if_else(...)
            n_valid == 0 ~ NA_real_,
            n_high  == 0 ~ 0,
            TRUE         ~ n_high / n_valid
        )
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(nd_cat = factor(case_when(
      is.na(ratio)  ~ NA_character_,  # <- also catch NA here
      ratio == 0   ~ "Never",
      ratio <  0.5 ~ "Sometimes (0-50%)",
      ratio >= 0.5 ~ "Often (>=50%)"
    ), levels = c("Never", "Sometimes (0-50%)", "Often (>=50%)"))) |>
    select(pid, nd_cat, ratio)
}

      rename(NondiffWk66_w2 = nd_cat, Ratio_NDWk_w2 = ratio),
    by = "pid") |>
  left_join(
    nondiff_ratio(waves |> filter(Participation_w3 == "Participated"),
                  nd_w3St_raw, "Interviewmode_w3") |>
      rename(NondiffSt66_w3 = nd_cat, Ratio_NDStr_w3 = ratio),
    by = "pid") |>
  left_join(
    nondiff_ratio(waves |> filter(Participation_w3 == "Participated"),
                  nd_w3Wk_raw, "Interviewmode_w3") |>
      rename(NondiffWk66_w3 = nd_cat, Ratio_NDWk_w3 = ratio),
    by = "pid")


waves <- 
  waves |> 
  # Recode non-participants to "Not participated"
  mutate(
    NondiffSt66_w2 = factor(case_when(
      Participation_w2 == "Not participated" ~ "Not participated",
      TRUE ~ as.character(NondiffSt66_w2)), levels = c("Never","Sometimes (0-50%)","Often (>=50%)","Not participated")),
    NondiffWk66_w2 = factor(case_when(
      Participation_w2 == "Not participated" ~ "Not participated",
      TRUE ~ as.character(NondiffWk66_w2)), levels = c("Never","Sometimes (0-50%)","Often (>=50%)","Not participated")),
    NondiffSt66_w3 = factor(case_when(
      Participation_w3 == "Not participated" ~ "Not participated",
      TRUE ~ as.character(NondiffSt66_w3)), levels = c("Never","Sometimes (0-50%)","Often (>=50%)","Not participated")),
    NondiffWk66_w3 = factor(case_when(
      Participation_w3 == "Not participated" ~ "Not participated",
      TRUE ~ as.character(NondiffWk66_w3)), levels = c("Never","Sometimes (0-50%)","Often (>=50%)","Not participated"))
  )


waves |> count(Interviewmode_w2,NondiffSt66_w2) 
waves |> filter(Sample == "Sample") |>filter(is.na(NondiffSt66_Sample_w1)) |>
```
