# Summary Table

```{r}
p_load(gtsummary)

# ── 1. Helper function: tbl_summary by interview mode ───────────────────────────
make_tbl <- function(data, mode_label) {
  data |>
    filter(Interviewmode == mode_label) |>
    mutate(across(
      any_of(c("Extremes", "Midpoint", "FrTMis", "INR66")),
      ~ as.character(.x) |> na_if("Not applicable") |> factor() |> fct_drop()
    )) |>
    select(TargetGroup, Age_3grp, Gender, Migration, Education, ChildHH, EquivIncome,
           Extremes, Midpoint, Speeding, FrTMis, INR66,
           NondiffStrong, NondiffWeak, BreakOff) |>
    tbl_summary(
      statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
      missing   = "no",
      label     = list(
        TargetGroup            ~ "Target Group",
        Age_3grp      ~ "Age group",
        Gender        ~ "Gender",
        Migration     ~ "Migration background",
        Education     ~ "Education",
        ChildHH       ~ "Child in Household",
        EquivIncome   ~ "Equivalized Income",
        Extremes      ~ "Extremes Selection",
        Midpoint      ~ "Midpoint Selection",
        Speeding      ~ "Speeding",
        FrTMis        ~ "Open Question Nonresponse",
        INR66         ~ "Closed Question Nonresponse",
        NondiffStrong ~ "Strong Nondifferentiation",
        NondiffWeak   ~ "Weak Nondifferentiation",
        BreakOff      ~ "Break-Off"
      )
    ) |>
    bold_labels() |>
    italicize_levels()
}


# ── 2. Helper function: reshape and filter by wave ──────────────────────────────
prep_wave <- function(suffix, wave_label,
                      extr, mid, speed, frtmis, inr, ndst, ndwk,
                      age_cat, equivinc,
                      part_var    = NULL,
                      sample_only = FALSE) {
  d <- waves |>
    select(
      TargetGroup = TargetGroup_w1,
      Education     = Education_w1,
      Gender        = Gender_w1,
      ChildHH       = ChildHH_w1,
      Migration     = Mig_w1,
      Age_cat       = all_of(age_cat),
      EquivIncome   = all_of(equivinc),
      Interviewmode = all_of(paste0("Interviewmode_", suffix)),
      BreakOff      = all_of(paste0("BreakOff_", suffix)),
      Extremes      = all_of(extr),
      Midpoint      = all_of(mid),
      Speeding      = all_of(speed),
      FrTMis        = all_of(frtmis),
      INR66         = all_of(inr),
      NondiffStrong = all_of(ndst),
      NondiffWeak   = all_of(ndwk),
      any_of(c(part_var, "Sample"))
    ) |>
    mutate(
      BreakOff = case_when(
        as.character(BreakOff) == "No Break-off" ~ "No",
        as.character(BreakOff) == "Break-off"    ~ "Yes",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ) |> factor(levels = c("No", "Yes")),

      INR66 = case_when(
        as.character(INR66) == "Yes"              ~ "High",
        as.character(INR66) == "No"               ~ "Not high",
        as.character(INR66) == "High"             ~ "High",
        as.character(INR66) == "Not high"         ~ "Not high",
        as.character(INR66) == "Not participated" ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ) |> factor(levels = c("Not high", "High")),

      NondiffStrong = if_else(
        as.character(NondiffStrong) == "Not participated", NA_character_, as.character(NondiffStrong)
      ) |> factor() |> fct_drop(),

      NondiffWeak = if_else(
        as.character(NondiffWeak) == "Not participated", NA_character_, as.character(NondiffWeak)
      ) |> factor() |> fct_drop()
    )

  if (!is.null(part_var)) d <- d |> filter(.data[[part_var]] == "Participated")
  if (sample_only)        d <- d |> filter(Sample == "Sample")

  d |>
    mutate(
      Age_3grp = case_when(
        str_detect(Age_cat, "T1") ~ "18–40 yrs",
        str_detect(Age_cat, "T2") ~ "41–60 yrs",
        str_detect(Age_cat, "T3") ~ "> 60 yrs"
      ) |> factor(levels = c("18–40 yrs", "41–60 yrs", "> 60 yrs")),
      Interviewmode = factor(Interviewmode, levels = c("PAPI", "CAWI"))
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(Interviewmode))
}

# ── 3. Helper function: merge PAPI + CAWI with N in the header ──────────────────────
build_wave_tbl <- function(d, wave_label) {
  n_papi <- d |> filter(Interviewmode == "PAPI") |> nrow()
  n_cawi <- d |> filter(Interviewmode == "CAWI") |> nrow()

  tbl_merge(
    tbls        = list(make_tbl(d, "PAPI"), make_tbl(d, "CAWI")),
    tab_spanner = c("**PAPI**", "**CAWI**")   # spanning header = mode
  ) |>
    modify_header(
      stat_0_1 ~ paste0("**PAPI**  \nN = ", format(n_papi, big.mark = ",")),
      stat_0_2 ~ paste0("**CAWI**  \nN = ", format(n_cawi, big.mark = ","))
    )
}

# ── 4. Prepare data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
d_w1_sens <- prep_wave(
  suffix = "w1", wave_label = "Wave 1 (sensan)",
  extr  = "Extr_sensan_w1",        mid    = "Mid_sensan_w1",
  speed = "Speeding_sensan_w1",    frtmis = "FrTMis_sensan_w1",
  inr   = "INR66_sensan_w1",
  ndst  = "NondiffSt66_sensan_w1", ndwk   = "NondiffWk66_sensan_w1",
  age_cat = "Age_cat_sensan_w1",   equivinc = "EquivIncome_sensan_w1"
)

d_w1_samp <- prep_wave(
  suffix = "w1", wave_label = "Wave 1 (Sample)",
  extr  = "Extr_Sample_w1",        mid    = "Mid_Sample_w1",
  speed = "Speeding_Sample_w1",    frtmis = "FrTMis_Sample_w1",
  inr   = "INR66_Sample_w1",
  ndst  = "NondiffSt66_Sample_w1", ndwk   = "NondiffWk66_Sample_w1",
  age_cat = "Age_cat_Sample_w1",   equivinc = "EquivIncome_Sample_w1",
  sample_only = TRUE
)

d_w12 <- prep_wave(
  suffix = "w2", wave_label = "Wave 2",
  extr  = "Extr_w2",     mid    = "Mid_w2",
  speed = "Speeding_w2", frtmis = "FrTMis_w2",
  inr   = "INR66_w2",
  ndst  = "NondiffSt66_w2", ndwk = "NondiffWk66_w2",
  age_cat  = "Age_cat_sensan_w1", equivinc = "EquivIncome_sensan_w1",
  part_var = "Participation_w2"
)

d_w3 <- prep_wave(
  suffix = "w3", wave_label = "Wave 3",
  extr  = "Extr_w3",     mid    = "Mid_w3",
  speed = "Speeding_w3", frtmis = "FrTMis_w3",
  inr   = "INR66_w3",
  ndst  = "NondiffSt66_w3", ndwk = "NondiffWk66_w3",
  age_cat  = "Age_cat_sensan_w1", equivinc = "EquivIncome_sensan_w1",
  part_var = "Participation_w3"
)

# ── 5. Build tables ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tbl_w1_sens <- build_wave_tbl(d_w1_sens, "Wave 1 (sensan)")
tbl_w1_samp <- build_wave_tbl(d_w1_samp, "Wave 1 (Sample)")
tbl_w12     <- build_wave_tbl(d_w12,     "Wave 2")
tbl_w3      <- build_wave_tbl(d_w3,      "Wave 3")

# ── 6. Merge all waves side by side ───────────────────────────────────────────
tbl_final <- tbl_merge(
  tbls        = list(tbl_w1_sens, tbl_w1_samp, tbl_w12, tbl_w3),
  tab_spanner = c("**Wave 1 – sensan**", "**Wave 1 – Sample**",
                  "**Wave 2**",            "**Wave 3**")
) |>
 # modify_caption("**Sample Characteristics by Wave and Interview Mode**") |>
  modify_header(label ~ "**Sample Characteristics**")

tbl_final



```


```{r}
p_load(kableExtra, stringr)

latex_raw <- tbl_final |>
  as_kable_extra(
    format   = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    escape   = FALSE
  ) |>
  as.character()

latex_clean <- latex_raw |>
  # bold spans → \textbf{}
  str_replace_all(
    '<span style=" font-weight: bold;[^"]*"[^>]*>(.*?)</span>',
    '\\\\textbf{\\1}'
  ) |>
  # italic spans → \textit{}
  str_replace_all(
    '<span style="  font-style: italic;[^"]*"[^>]*>(.*?)</span>',
    '\\\\textit{\\1}'
  )

cat(latex_clean)
```

```{r}
# LCA input dummies, main sample (saved below as waves_dummies_sample.RData
# for the LCA scripts in the wave folders).
# Coding: 1 = reference/no, 2 = yes (Mplus CATEGORICAL, see README legend)
waves_dummies_Sample <- 
  waves |>
  select(-contains("_sensan")) |> 
  filter(Sample == "Sample") |> 
  mutate(
    # --- Demographics ---
    AGET1   = case_when(Age_cat_Sample_w1 == "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]"  ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    AGET3   = case_when(Age_cat_Sample_w1 == "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]"  ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    MIGY    = case_when(Mig_w1            == "Yes"                 ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    GENF    = case_when(Gender_w1         == "Female"              ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    EDTERT  = case_when(Education_w1 == "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)"    ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    EDNA    = case_when(Education_w1 == "missing"                  ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    EMPP    = case_when(Employment_w1 == "Part-time or flexible"              ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    EMPNO   = case_when(Employment_w1 == "Not currently employed, training"   ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    EMPRET  = case_when(Employment_w1 == "Retirement"                         ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    EMPNA   = case_when(Employment_w1 == "missing"                            ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    KIDY    = case_when(ChildHH_w1 == "Child in hh" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    KIDNA   = case_when(ChildHH_w1 == "missing"      ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    INCT1   = case_when(EquivIncome_Sample_w1 == "EquivIncome_T1min" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    INCT3   = case_when(EquivIncome_Sample_w1 == "EquivIncome_T3max" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    INCNA   = case_when(EquivIncome_Sample_w1 == "missing"           ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Target Group ---
    TGANC   = case_when(TargetGroup_w1 == "Anchor" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Extreme Responding ---
    EXT1    = case_when(Extr_Sample_w1 == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    EXT2    = case_when(Extr_w2        == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    EXT3    = case_when(Extr_w3          == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Midpoint Responding ---
    MID1    = case_when(Mid_Sample_w1 == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    MID2    = case_when(Mid_w2        == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    MID3    = case_when(Mid_w3          == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Break-Off ---
    BO1     = case_when(BreakOff_w1 == "Break-off" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    BO2     = case_when(BreakOff_w2 == "Break-off" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    BO3     = case_when(BreakOff_w3   == "Break-off" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Speeding ---
    SPEE1   = case_when(Speeding_Sample_w1 == "Speeding" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    SPEE2   = case_when(Speeding_w2        == "Speeding" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    SPEE3   = case_when(Speeding_w3          == "Speeding" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Free Text Missingness ---
    FTM1    = case_when(FrTMis_Sample_w1 == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    FTM2    = case_when(FrTMis_w2        == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    FTM3    = case_when(FrTMis_w3          == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Item Nonresponse ---
    INR1    = case_when(INR66_Sample_w1 == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    INR2    = case_when(INR66_w2        == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    INR3    = case_when(INR66_w3          == "High" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Nondiff Strong Sometimes ---
    NDSS1   = case_when(NondiffSt66_Sample_w1 == "Sometimes (0-50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    NDSS2   = case_when(NondiffSt66_w2        == "Sometimes (0-50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    NDSS3   = case_when(NondiffSt66_w3          == "Sometimes (0-50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Nondiff Weak Often ---
    NDWO1   = case_when(NondiffWk66_Sample_w1 == "Often (>=50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    NDWO2   = case_when(NondiffWk66_w2        == "Often (>=50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    NDWO3   = case_when(NondiffWk66_w3          == "Often (>=50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    
    # --- Nondiff Strong Often ---
    NDSO1   = case_when(NondiffSt66_Sample_w1 == "Often (>=50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    NDSO2   = case_when(NondiffSt66_w2        == "Often (>=50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1),
    NDSO3   = case_when(NondiffSt66_w3          == "Often (>=50%)" ~ 2, TRUE ~ 1)
  )


waves_dummies_Sample |> select(AGET1:NDSO3) |> ai()
```

```{r}
waves_dummies_sensan |> count(INR1,  INR66_sensan_w1)
waves_dummies_sensan |> count(NDSS1, NondiffSt66_sensan_w1)
waves_dummies_sensan |> count(NDSO1, NondiffSt66_sensan_w1)

# save for the sensitivity-analysis LCA R scripts in the wave1_*_sensan folders (they load ../waves_dummies_sensan.RData)
save(waves_dummies_sensan, file = file.path(userpath, "waves_dummies_sensan.RData"))
```
